title: Olivia Rodrigo, Taylor Swift & Ariana Grande: Which Pop Stars Won June 2026? Greatest Pop Stars Podcast
summary: This Who Won the Month episode of the 'Greatest Pop Stars' podcast looks at the big names who helped close out the first half of 2026 in pop stardom.
contentText:
It’s a wrap on the first half of the 2026 calendar year in pop stardom — and while we haven’t gotten a ton of totally new chart-topping artists to this point in the year, we have heard all year from a whole lot of the ruling classic of the last decade (or two). This past June was no exception to that trend, as some of the biggest names of recent years returned with new albums, new singles, new tours and/or big new moments, making sure that we enter the back half of the year still reeling from the star power on display.

This week on the  Greatest Pop Stars  podcast , we catch up with all the stars who defined June 2026 in pop stardom. Host Andrew Unterberger is joined by  Billboard  staffers Xander Zellner and Emily Fuentes to share and debate our respective June top five lists, while also naming some honorable mentions, some disappointments, and some artists who we’re looking forward to in the second half of the year. (If you want to listen back to our first four 2026 recaps, or any of our 2025 episodes, you can  check them all out here .)

And of course, we ask all the most pressing questions about the month in pop stardom: Is Olivia Rodrigo already thinking about her long-term legacy at age 23? Is Taylor Swift still as dominant as ever in this in-between year for her — and will it actually end up being an in-between year at all? Have we come around to Ariana Grande’s “Hate That I Made You Love Me?” Has Malcolm Todd proven himself to be the real deal? How are we feeling about Phoebe Bridgers’ return six years after her last solo album? What are our current reads on upcoming albums by Gracie Abrams, Charli xcx and Carly Rae Jepsen? And of course most importantly: Who has been the Greatest Pop Star of the first half of 2026?
